name: The Moonshell Covenant
source:
After six months living on her own in Dawnholm, junior detective Agatha Griffiths has slowly earned her place within the city police department. Now her daily life consists of helping her mentors make the world a safer and better place, as her brother would've wanted...

However, during the investigation of a murder related to a major case of drug trafficking across the city, Agatha will be plunged into the middle of a dark and twisted game as ancient as humanity.

Under the light of the pale moon, her whole life suddenly turns upside down. Her brother's dream, the bright future she's worked so hard to chase, will vanish before her eyes. And if she's not careful... her own life may be forfeit as well.

Will she see the light of the next full moon?

[From [url=https://gobusanz.itch.io/the-moonshell-covenant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻警探阿加莎·格里菲斯在黎明城独自生活了半年，慢慢在市警局站稳了脚跟。如今，她每天都帮着前辈们让世界变得更好、更安全，正如哥哥生前所愿…

然而，全城一起重大毒品走私案牵出了一桩谋杀。调查期间，阿加莎被卷入一场黑暗扭曲的游戏，它的历史几乎与人类一样古老。

惨白的月光下，她的人生骤然颠覆。哥哥的梦想、她为之不懈努力的光明未来，都将从她眼前消失。稍有不慎…连她自己的命也要赔进去。

她还能见到下一轮满月的光吗？

［摘自[url=https://gobusanz.itch.io/the-moonshell-covenant]itch.io[/url]］
